items.title: Police detain 3 protesters during overnight rally as Polish president backs suspended judge
items.brief: Hundreds of anti-government protesters rallied overnight around a top court in Poland to denounce the suspension of the tribunal’s president, for which they blame the country’s pro-European government.

items.title: Cost-of-living protests set to spread to Germany on Halloween as France braces for fresh unrest
items.brief: Cost-of-living protests that began in France are spreading to Germany with tens of thousands of people expected to turn out across the country on Saturday for demonstrations that coincide with Halloween.

items.title: Zelensky welcomes sale of crucial US Patriot missiles but warns delivery could take years
items.brief: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky welcomed US approval of a potential $2.1 billion sale of 500 vital Patriot interceptor missiles on Friday, but warned that it may take “a few years” for them to arrive.

items.title: Hundreds evacuate Ukrainian city of Oleshky under Melania Trump-brokered ceasefire
items.brief: Hundreds of people from an occupied town in southern Ukraine who survived months without basic supplies were evacuated on Friday under a ceasefire agreement negotiated by first lady Melania Trump .
